work.note: The existing primary bibliography explicitly dates the seven-volume work 1913–1927; the survey begins with its first publication. The interval is publication across volumes, not a story-setting range.

tags: In the Shadow of Young Girls in Flower
description: Retells the first four volumes of Marcel Proust’s In Search of Lost Time, from the narrator’s childhood at Combray, the madeleine and Swann’s jealous pursuit of Odette to Gilberte, Albertine and the education in perception at Balbec. Follows the narrator into the Guermantes salons, the Dreyfus Affair, his grandmother’s death and the revelations about Charlus and Jupien, ending with his increasingly possessive plans for Albertine.
